model.name: gpt-oss-120b
model.about: OpenAI, mixture of experts (117B, 5.1B active), MXFP4 as released; the larger sibling of the approved 20b. Fits one 80 GB card. Measured on 2026-09-26 with the original harness (eval/RESULTS.md): same answers as the 20b on the twelve original questions, more than twice the GPU time per question, and no wrong draft on the stripped catalog where the 20b made one.

SELECT
    ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON txn.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND dt.CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT
  j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
  COUNT(*) AS aml_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alerts_2025 DESC;

SELECT
  br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
  COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND dt.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND dt.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dlq.CUST_K) AS clients_in_default_end_aug_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dlq.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND dlq.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT
    ct.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ct ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ct.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ct.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
  d.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
  AVG(rt.MID_RT) AS avg_daily_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D rt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON rt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY d.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY d.CCY_CD1;

SELECT
    fpv.MKT_K,
    SUM(fpv.NET_ASST_VAL1_AMT) AS total_portfolio_valuation
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D fpv
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fpv.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY fpv.MKT_K
ORDER BY fpv.MKT_K;

SELECT
    a.ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
    COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT a
WHERE a.OPND_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
    br.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY br.CTY_NM;

SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-12-01'

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS customer_count

FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c

  ON txn.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
        WHERE d.DT_K = txn.BUS_DT_K
          AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      )

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    ct.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ct ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ct.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ct.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY ct.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT SUM(dsp.TXN_AMT) AS total_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dsp.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
  dj.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
  COUNT(*) AS aml_alerts_high_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT fa
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR dj ON fa.JUR_K = dj.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dd ON fa.BUS_DT_K = dd.DT_K
WHERE fa.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dd.CAL_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY dj.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY dj.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.LN_ID) AS loans_over_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

WITH target_date AS (
    SELECT DT_K
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
    WHERE CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT
    prd.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(dsb.PR NCP_AMT), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(rpm.PR NCP_PAID_AMT), 0) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD prd
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS dsb
    ON dsb.LN_PRD_K = prd.LN_PRD_K
    AND dsb.BUS_DT_K <= (SELECT DT_K FROM target_date)
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT rpm
    ON rpm.LN_PRD_K = prd.LN_PRD_K
    AND rpm.BUS_DT_K <= (SELECT DT_K FROM target_date)
GROUP BY prd.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY prd.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ft.CUST_K) AS distinct_sme_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF ft
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST dc ON ft.CUST_K = dc.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dd ON ft.BUS_DT_K = dd.DT_K
WHERE dc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND ft.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND dd.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH atm_2025 AS (
  SELECT f.BR_K,
         d.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
         b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
         COUNT(*) AS txn_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d ON f.BR_K = d.BR_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND b.IS_CURR = TRUE
    AND d.IS_CURR = TRUE
  GROUP BY f.BR_K, d.RGN_CD1, b.DSPLY_NM
), ranked AS (
  SELECT region_code,
         branch_name,
         txn_cnt,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY txn_cnt DESC) AS rn
  FROM atm_2025
)
SELECT region_code,
       branch_name,
       txn_cnt AS atm_transactions
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT
    mc.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
    SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH_CTG mc ON f.MRCH_CTG_K = mc.MRCH_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY mc.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
  c.BUS_ID AS business_id,
  SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  dc.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
  SUM(fwt.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF fwt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fwt.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY dc ON fwt.CCY_K = dc.CCY_K
WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dc.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY dc.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cust_k) AS distinct_customers_2025
FROM (
    SELECT f_atm.cust_k
    FROM bank_dwh.f_atm_txn f_atm
    JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d_atm ON f_atm.bus_dt_k = d_atm.dt_k
    WHERE d_atm.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
    INTERSECT
    SELECT f_wr.cust_k
    FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf f_wr
    JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d_wr ON f_wr.bus_dt_k = d_wr.dt_k
    WHERE d_wr.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
) sub;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON wt.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS bank_dwh.F_CMPLT;

UPDATE bank_dwh.D_CUST
SET CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'AFFLUENT'
WHERE CTY_NM = 'Cluj-Napoca'
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wknd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT d.is_wknd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.f_atm_txn t
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON t.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a1.ACCT_K) AS accounts_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D a1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d1 ON a1.BUS_DT_K = d1.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D a2 ON a1.ACCT_K = a2.ACCT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d2 ON a2.BUS_DT_K = d2.DT_K
WHERE d1.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND d2.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'
  AND a1.CLSNG_BAL_AMT < a2.CLSNG_BAL_AMT * 0.90;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cur.CUST_K) AS customers_with_changed_segment
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST cur
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST prev
  ON cur.CUST_K = prev.CUST_K
  AND prev.IS_CURR = FALSE
  AND cur.VRSN_NBR = prev.VRSN_NBR + 1
WHERE cur.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND cur.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 <> prev.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.cust_k) AS distinct_customers
FROM   bank_dwh.f_acct_txn t
JOIN   bank_dwh.d_dt d ON t.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE  d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP  BY t.cust_k
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.qtr_nbr) = 4;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cd.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT cd
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dispt ON cd.BUS_DT_K = d_dispt.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr ON wr.CUST_K = cd.CUST_K
    AND wr.BUS_DT_K = d_dispt.DT_K
WHERE d_dispt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND cd.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr2
        JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_wr ON wr2.BUS_DT_K = d_wr.DT_K
        WHERE wr2.CUST_K = cd.CUST_K
          AND d_wr.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    );

WITH d2024 AS (
  SELECT ln_id
  FROM bank_dwh.f_ln_dsbrs f
  JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
  WHERE d.cal_dt = DATE '2024-06-30'
    AND f.dys_pst_due = 0
), d2025 AS (
  SELECT ln_id
  FROM bank_dwh.f_ln_dsbrs f
  JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON f.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
  WHERE d.cal_dt = DATE '2025-06-30'
    AND f.dys_pst_due > 30
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d2024.ln_id) AS loans_zero_due_then_over_30
FROM d2024
JOIN d2025 ON d2024.ln_id = d2025.ln_id;

SELECT
  c.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f.ORGNL_AMT) AS median_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY c.CCY_CD1;

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
       SUM(ab.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM   bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D ab
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_DT d
       ON ab.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND  d.IS_MTH_END = TRUE
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS cust_cnt_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN bank_dwh.F_CUST_INTRC i ON i.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON i.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SNC_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    d.cust_sgmnt_cd1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.cust_k) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.d_cust d
WHERE d.eff_frm_dt <= DATE '2023-06-30'
  AND (d.eff_to_dt > DATE '2023-06-30' OR d.is_curr)
GROUP BY d.cust_sgmnt_cd1
ORDER BY d.cust_sgmnt_cd1;

WITH wr_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    f.CUST_K,
    f.ORGNL_AMT
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
), cust_cur AS (
  SELECT
    c.CUST_K,
    c.BUS_ID,
    c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
  WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
), agg AS (
  SELECT
    cu.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
    cu.BUS_ID AS business_id,
    SUM(COALESCE(w.ORGNL_AMT, 0)) AS total_amount
  FROM cust_cur cu
  LEFT JOIN wr_2025 w ON cu.CUST_K = w.CUST_K
  GROUP BY cu.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, cu.BUS_ID
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    segment_code,
    business_id,
    total_amount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment_code ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS rn
  FROM agg
)
SELECT
  segment_code,
  business_id,
  total_amount
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY segment_code, total_amount DESC;

SELECT
  dc.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_total
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY dc ON f.CCY_K = dc.CCY_K
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
GROUP BY dc.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY pct_of_total DESC;

WITH wr AS (
  SELECT dt.MTH_NBR AS month_num,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY dt.MTH_NBR
  ORDER BY dt.MTH_NBR
), running AS (
  SELECT month_num,
         cnt,
         SUM(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY month_num ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_total
  FROM wr
)
SELECT month_num,
       cnt AS wire_transfer_cnt,
       running_total
FROM running
ORDER BY month_num;

SELECT SUM(
        CASE WHEN ccy_iso.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN trf.ORGNL_AMT
             ELSE trf.ORGNL_AMT / fx.MID_RT
        END
    ) AS total_wire_transfer_eur_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF trf
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON trf.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy_iso ON trf.CCY_K = ccy_iso.CCY_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
    ON fx.BUS_DT_K = trf.BUS_DT_K
   AND fx.CCY_K = trf.CCY_K
   AND fx.MID_RT IS NOT NULL
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH fee_events AS (
    SELECT
        f.BUS_DT_K,
        d.CAL_DT,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM d.CAL_DT) AS month_nbr,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) AS year_nbr,
        CASE WHEN f.AUTH_RSLT_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_declined
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
), agg AS (
    SELECT
        month_nbr,
        SUM(is_declined) AS declined_cnt,
        COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
    FROM fee_events
    GROUP BY month_nbr
)
SELECT
    month_nbr AS month_number,
    ROUND(100.0 * declined_cnt / NULLIF(total_cnt,0), 2) AS declined_share_percent
FROM agg
ORDER BY declined_share_percent DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    c.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY c.CCY_CD1;

SELECT d_chln.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
       COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM   bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f_txn
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_CHNL d_chln
       ON f_txn.CHNL_K = d_chln.CHNL_K
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt
       ON f_txn.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
WHERE  d_dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d_chln.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT
  dj.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
  COUNT(*) AS aml_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT fa
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR dj ON fa.JUR_K = dj.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dd ON fa.BUS_DT_K = dd.DT_K
WHERE dd.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dj.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alerts_2025 DESC;

SELECT
  br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
  COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

INSERT INTO bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D (
    BUS_DT_K,
    CCY_K,
    CCY_CD1,
    MID_RT,
    RT_DT_K,
    EFF_DT_K,
    EXPRY_DT_K,
    SRC_SYS_CD1,
    LOAD_BTCH_ID,
    INGST_AT,
    REC_HSH,
    DATA_QLY_STS_CD1
) SELECT
    d.DT_K               AS BUS_DT_K,
    c.CCY_K              AS CCY_K,
    c.ISO_ALPH_CD1       AS CCY_CD1,
    1.10::NUMERIC(14,8)  AS MID_RT,
    d.DT_K               AS RT_DT_K,   -- effective date same as business date
    d.DT_K               AS EFF_DT_K,  -- effective date same as business date
    NULL                 AS EXPRY_DT_K, -- unknown expiry, left null
    'USER_INSERT'        AS SRC_SYS_CD1,
    'INSERT_2025_12_31'  AS LOAD_BTCH_ID,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP    AS INGST_AT,
    md5(random()::text)  AS REC_HSH,
    'ACTIVE'             AS DATA_QLY_STS_CD1
FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD'
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31';

JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D a30 ON a30.ACCT_K = a31.ACCT_K

WHERE d31.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'

SELECT

JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON t.CCY_K = c.CCY_K

SELECT d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,

       ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE  d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR

SELECT
    dc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dc.CUST_K) AS customer_count

ORDER BY dc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

SELECT segment_code,
       cust_bus_id,
       total_amt
FROM (
    SELECT d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
           d.BUS_ID AS cust_bus_id,
           SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_amt,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) DESC) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE d.IS_CURR = TRUE
      AND dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
    GROUP BY d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, d.BUS_ID
) sub
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY segment_code, total_amt DESC;

  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_total
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

    dt.MTH_NBR AS month_num,
    COUNT(*) AS wr_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K

  SUM(wr_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY month_num ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS running_total

SELECT
    c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
    AVG(daily_mid_rt) AS avg_daily_mid_rate
FROM (
    SELECT
        rt.CCY_K,
        dt.CAL_DT,
        AVG(rt.MID_RT) AS daily_mid_rt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D rt
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON rt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
      AND rt.MID_RT IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY rt.CCY_K, dt.CAL_DT
) daily_rates
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON daily_rates.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
GROUP BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT
    fpv.MKT_ID AS market_id,
    SUM(fpv.NET_ASST_VAL1_AMT) AS total_portfolio_valuation
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D fpv
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fpv.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY fpv.MKT_ID
ORDER BY total_portfolio_valuation DESC;

SELECT
    a.ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
    COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT a
WHERE a.OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND a.OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND a.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
    br.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY br.CTY_NM;

SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate_usd_dec_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-12-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31';

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.cust_k) AS customers_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
    WHERE t.cust_k = c.cust_k
      AND d.cal_dt BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
);

SELECT
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    ct.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ct ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ct.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY ct.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY ct.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT SUM(dsp.TXN_AMT) AS total_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT dsp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dsp.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.CAL_DT) = 2025;

SELECT
  dj.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
  COUNT(*) AS high_severity_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT fa
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR dj ON fa.JUR_K = dj.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dd ON fa.BUS_DT_K = dd.DT_K
WHERE fa.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND dd.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dj.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY dj.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LN_ID) AS loans_over_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND d.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT
    p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(d.PRnCP_AMT), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(r.PRnCP_PAID_AMT), 0) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS d
  ON d.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
  AND d.BUS_DT_K IN (
        SELECT dt.DT_K
        FROM bank_dwh.D_DT dt
        WHERE dt.CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31'
    )
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT r
  ON r.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
  AND r.BUS_DT_K IN (
        SELECT dt.DT_K
        FROM bank_dwh.D_DT dt
        WHERE dt.CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-12-31'
    )
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY p.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ft.CUST_K) AS distinct_sme_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF ft
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST dc ON ft.CUST_K = dc.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dd ON ft.BUS_DT_K = dd.DT_K
WHERE dc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND ft.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND dd.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH atm_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f_atm_txn.br_k,
        d_br.rgn_cd1 AS region_code,
        d_br.dsply_nm AS branch_name,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f_atm_txn
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt
        ON f_atm_txn.bus_dt_k = d_dt.dt_k
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR d_br
        ON f_atm_txn.br_k = d_br.br_k
    WHERE d_dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
      AND d_br.is_curr = TRUE
      AND d_br.is_actv = TRUE
    GROUP BY f_atm_txn.br_k, d_br.rgn_cd1, d_br.dsply_nm
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        region_code,
        branch_name,
        atm_txn_cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY atm_txn_cnt DESC) AS rn
    FROM atm_2025
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_txn_cnt AS atm_transactions
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

SELECT
    mc.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code,
    SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MRCH_CTG mc ON f.MRCH_CTG_K = mc.MRCH_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY mc.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
  c.BUS_ID AS business_id,
  SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.ORGNL_AMT IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  dc.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
  SUM(fwt.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF fwt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt ON fwt.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY dc ON fwt.CCY_K = dc.CCY_K
WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY dc.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY dc.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

WITH atm_cust AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
),
wire_cust AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
  SELECT CUST_K FROM atm_cust
  INTERSECT
  SELECT CUST_K FROM wire_cust
) sub;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON wt.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT dt.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM   bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN   bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE  dt.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR;

/* Delete duplicate rows in bank_dwh.D_CUST, keeping the latest version per business identifier (BUS_ID).
   Assumption: duplicates are rows with the same BUS_ID; the row with the highest VRSN_NBR (or latest EFF_FRM_DT) is the one to keep. */
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT CUST_K,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY VRSN_NBR DESC, EFF_FRM_DT DESC) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
)
DELETE FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
USING ranked r
WHERE D_CUST.CUST_K = r.CUST_K
  AND r.rn > 1;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS bank_dwh.F_CMPLT;

SELECT DSPLY_NM FROM bank_dwh.D_BR;
TRUNCATE TABLE bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wknd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT d.is_wknd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_cnt

JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt d ON t.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a1.ACCT_K) AS accounts_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D a1
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d1 ON a1.BUS_DT_K = d1.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D a2 ON a1.ACCT_K = a2.ACCT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d2 ON a2.BUS_DT_K = d2.DT_K

  AND d2.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'
  AND a1.CLSNG_BAL_AMT < a2.CLSNG_BAL_AMT * 0.90;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_changed_segment
FROM (
    SELECT cur.CUST_K,
           cur.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS curr_segment,
           prev.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS prev_segment
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST cur
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1
        FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST p
        WHERE p.CUST_K = cur.CUST_K
          AND p.IS_CURR = FALSE
        ORDER BY p.VRSN_NBR DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) prev ON TRUE
    WHERE cur.IS_CURR = TRUE
) sub
WHERE sub.prev_segment IS NOT NULL
  AND sub.curr_segment <> sub.prev_segment;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT custs.cust_k) AS distinct_customers
FROM (
    SELECT ft.cust_k
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN ft
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON ft.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k
    WHERE dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
    GROUP BY ft.cust_k
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dt.qtr_nbr) = 4
) custs;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cd.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT cd
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON cd.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr ON wr.CUST_K = cd.CUST_K AND wr.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND cd.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
  AND wr.WR_TRF_F_K IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d0.LN_ID) AS loans_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS d0
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt0 ON d0.BUS_DT_K = dt0.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS d1 ON d0.LN_ID = d1.LN_ID
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt1 ON d1.BUS_DT_K = dt1.DT_K
WHERE dt0.CAL_DT = DATE '2024-06-30'
  AND dt1.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'
  AND d0.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
  AND d1.DYS_PST_DUE > 30;

SELECT
    c.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.ORGNL_AMT) AS median_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t

WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

WITH month_ends AS (

    d.DT_K,
    d.CAL_DT,
    d.MTH_NBR,

GROUP BY me.MTH_NBR

    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_total

    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt,
    SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY d.mth_nbr) AS running_total
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON wt.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY d.mth_nbr

SELECT SUM(
        CASE WHEN ccy_iso.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN trf.ORGNL_AMT
             ELSE trf.ORGNL_AMT / fx.MID_RT
        END
    ) AS total_wire_transfer_eur_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF trf
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON trf.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy_iso ON trf.CCY_K = ccy_iso.CCY_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx

   AND fx.BUS_DT_K = trf.BUS_DT_K

WHERE  d.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
GROUP BY d.mth_nbr
ORDER BY declined_share_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;
